_id.description: The unique identifier for a file.

createdAt.description: The date and time when the file record was created.

mimeType.description: The MIME type of the file, indicating its format.

originalName.description: The original name of the file as uploaded by the user.

size.description: The size of the file in bytes.

status.description: The current status of the file, such as 'uploaded' or 'processed'.

storageName.description: The name used to store the file in the storage system.

storagePath.description: The path where the file is stored in the storage system.

updatedAt.description: The date and time when the file record was last updated.
